clinical.citation: Missense ABI2 variants linked to a neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual disability, epilepsy, hypoplasia of the corpus callosum, and white matter abnormalities (PMID: 40475134)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: de novo variants in unrelated individuals; p.Tyr491Cys found in 6 of 8 patients in highly conserved SH3 domain; associated with severe neurodevelopmental phenotype

clinical.citation: Mapping autosomal recessive intellectual disability: combined microarray and exome sequencing identifies 26 novel candidate genes in 192 consanguineous families (PMID: 28397838)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: identified in consanguineous families with homozygous loss-of-function mutations; high expression in prenatal brain

model_organism.citation: ABI2-deficient mice exhibit defective cell migration, aberrant dendritic spine morphogenesis, and deficits in learning and memory (PMID: 15572692)
phenotypes: Defective secondary lens fiber orientation and migration in the eye
Defective cell migration in neocortex and hippocampus
Abnormal dendritic spine morphology and density
Abnormal phenotypes in eye and brain tissues

model_organism.citation: Analysis of genome-wide knockout mouse database identifies candidate ciliopathy genes (PMID: 36456625)
phenotypes: Histological and morphological evidence of ciliopathy phenotypes

model_organism.citation: Essential role for Abi1 in embryonic survival and WAVE2 complex integrity (PMID: 21482783)
phenotypes: Embryonic lethality at approximately embryonic day 11.5
Defective regulation of actin cytoskeleton in MEFs
Decreased cell migration rate and distance
Reduced levels of WAVE complex components (WAVE1, WAVE2, Nap1, Sra-1/PIR121)

biological.summary: ABI2 is a type 2C protein phosphatase that functions as a co-receptor in ABA signaling. Binding of ABA to RCARs/PYR1/PYLs leads to inactivation of ABI2, which launches SNF1-type kinase action targeting ABA-dependent gene expression and ion channels.

biological.citation: Regulators of PP2C phosphatase activity function as abscisic acid sensors (PMID: 19407143)
biological.summary: ABI2 is a type 2C protein phosphatase that negatively regulates ABA responses and interacts with regulatory components of ABA receptor (RCARs). RCARs mediate ABA-dependent inactivation of ABI2 in vitro and antagonize PP2C action in planta, with evidence for combinatorial assembly of receptor complexes.

biological.citation: Phytocytokine signalling reopens stomata in plant immunity and water loss (PMID: 35508659)
biological.summary: ABI2 is phosphorylated by the NUT receptor kinase downstream of SCREW peptide signaling, leading to increased phosphatase activity toward OST1 kinase and reduced stomatal closure. This pathway counter-regulates ABA-induced stomatal closure to optimize plant fitness under stress.

biological.citation: The HHEX-ABI2/SLC17A9 axis induces cancer stem cell-like properties and tumorigenesis in HCC (PMID: 38844969)
biological.summary: ABI2 serves as a co-activator of transcription factor HHEX in hepatocellular carcinoma cells, promoting upregulation of SLC17A9 and cancer stem cell-like properties. ABI2 expression correlates with HCC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion.

biological.citation: Two E-clade protein phosphatase 2Cs enhance ABA signaling by dephosphorylating ABI1 in Arabidopsis (PMID: 40170353)
biological.summary: ABI2 is a co-receptor of ABA whose phosphorylation state regulates its ability to inhibit ABA signaling. ADEP1/2 phosphatases dephosphorylate ABI2 at Ser117, enhancing plant sensitivity to ABA and promoting ABA-induced stomatal closure and seed germination inhibition.

biological.citation: Phosphorylation dynamics of RAF12 and PP2C control SnRK2 activity under hyperosmotic stress in Arabidopsis (PMID: 40555240)
biological.summary: ABI2 is a type 2C protein phosphatase that cooperatively suppresses SnRK2 kinase activities during osmotic stress signaling. RAF12 kinase phosphorylates and inhibits ABI2 activity, releasing SnRK2 inhibition and promoting stress responses.
ABI2 is a type 2C protein phosphatase characterized as a negative regulator of ABA signal transduction with redundant action alongside ABI1 in the ABA signaling pathway.

biological.citation: PIM1 phosphorylates ABI2 to enhance actin dynamics and promote tumor invasion (PMID: 37042842)
biological.summary: ABI2 (Abl-interactor 2) is a member of the wave regulatory complex (WRC) that is phosphorylated by PIM1 kinase at Ser183 in prostate cancer cells. PIM1-mediated phosphorylation of ABI2 increases protein levels, enhances WRC formation, and promotes cell protrusion and invasion.

biological.citation: Inhibition of ABI2 ubiquitination-dependent degradation suppresses TNBC cell growth via down-regulating PI3K/Akt signaling pathway (PMID: 38937761)
biological.summary: ABI2 is a tumor suppressor protein in triple negative breast cancer that is ubiquitinated and degraded by E3 ligase CBLC. ABI2 interacts with Rho GTPase RAC1 to inhibit PI3K/Akt signaling and suppress TNBC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion.

biological.citation: In search of a function for the E3B1/Abi2/Argbp1/NESH family (PMID: 12011975)
biological.summary: ABI2 is an adaptor protein with homeobox homology domain, proline-rich region, and SH3 domain that interacts with Abl-family tyrosine kinases. ABI2 family members are involved in cytoskeletal reorganization including membrane-ruffling, lamellipodia formation, and cell migration.

biological.citation: ASHG 2010 - GxG interactions potentially account for the blood pressure linkage peak on chromosome 2 in the Old Order Amish
biological.summary: SNPs in the ABI2 gene locus on chromosome 2q31-34 show evidence for gene-by-gene interactions associated with diastolic blood pressure variation in the Old Order Amish population. SNPs in ABI2 introns were among 19 SNPs showing interaction effects that collectively accounted for 18% of DBP variation.
biological.significance: LOD score reduction of up to 34% for individual SNP pairs; 85% reduction with combination of 6 pairs
